entry_invariant: Any conversation entering an Enterprise Math RESEARCHER or RESEARCH_DRIVER role must resolve or allocate its role identity before substantive work begins. Researchers expose Researcher-ID; Drivers expose Driver-ID.
entry_events: resume of an existing Enterprise Math conversation
resolution_order: reuse the role identity already visible in the current conversation if one exists
reuse an unambiguous persisted role identity bound to this same conversation/session if available
for Driver-mediated manual relay, use the Researcher-ID preallocated in the dispatch envelope
for scheduler CLAIM, derive a deterministic Researcher-ID from task identity lane plus claim_id
otherwise generate a new role-appropriate short-code ID locally and persist it in the current conversation

lane_resolution.fallback: derive the compact Rxxx/Pxxx lane from task_id; otherwise use DIRECT

manual_dispatch.scope: Driver-mediated user relay into a new researcher conversation
manual_dispatch.derivation: SHA-256(task_id + NUL + dispatch_id), uppercase first 6 hex characters, prefixed by EM-<LANE>-
manual_dispatch.first_use: the receiving conversation preserves the preallocated Researcher-ID and shows it in its first substantive return

scheduler_claim.derivation: SHA-256(task_id + NUL + claim_id), uppercase first 6 hex characters, prefixed by EM-<LANE>-

role_transition.same_conversation: preserve the underlying execution handle and switch the visible role label; update Research-Role / Research-Task metadata
role_transition.primary_driver: EM-DRIVER-01 only when the conversation is explicitly the primary Driver continuity conversation

taskbook_contract.rule: Taskbooks declare the identity policy/lane, never a fixed runtime Researcher-ID. Manual relay binds a Researcher-ID in a separate dispatch envelope; scheduler/direct entry paths resolve identity independently.
taskbook_contract.legacy_taskbooks: inherit this state machine even when the field is absent

registration.registration_failure: REGISTER_PENDING; continue work and persist the role identity visibly; retry only at a semantic checkpoint
registration.legacy_path_name_note: the historical folder name researchers/ is retained for compatibility and may contain Driver identity records
